title.narrative: Community Economic Participation support to Farmers &Trade Associations

description.narrative: The project, "Community Economic Participation Enhancement Support to Farmers and Farmer Organizations," is implemented by the Malawi Union of Savings and Credit Cooperatives (MUSCCO) in the districts of Mchinji, Dedza, Dowa, Ntchisi, Salima, and Ntcheu in Malawi. Its main purpose is to strengthen farmer organizations and enhance the productive capacity of smallholder farmers, with a specific focus on empowering women and youth. The project aims to achieve this by facilitating improved access to financial services through Village Savings and Loans Associations (VSLAs) and their linkage to formal Savings and Credit Cooperatives (SACCOs). It also utilizes Study Circles for peer-to-peer learning on agricultural practices, financial literacy, climate resilience, and gender equality. Expected results include increased agricultural productivity, improved food security, and sustainable livelihoods for 30,000 direct beneficiaries (90% of whom are women and youth). Key activities involve forming and training VSLAs, linking them to SACCOs, conducting Study Circles, and building the capacity of farmer organizations to improve their commercial viability and advocacy.
